private_commit.note: Working repository is private; the public tree here is the exported content.

identity_algorithm: sha256(json.dumps(files, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))) over the 12,108 baseline paths, using file-content SHA-256

build_portability_overlay.reason: Old DTB combined-image rule must locate DTS sources from srctree for external O= builds.

build_entry_changes: Detect and link the BSD host library for legacy strlcpy/strlcat when the host libc lacks them.
Inject the first 12 SOURCE_REVISION hex characters into Kbuild GIT_HASH/GIT_VERSION and record the full revision and epoch.
Build into a separate external O= directory; no .git or fixed /tmp build path is required.

toolchain.download: No verified public download address is provided; build with a matching OpenWrt 8.4.0 musl EABI toolchain.

candidate_build_notes: Candidates are built with -ffile-prefix-map so compiled binaries carry a neutral /build/ root instead of a build-host path.
84 candidates = 4 boards x 21 OEM NAND profiles, all production defconfigs.
limitations: Not hardware-validated in this release; installation qualification is not claimed.
SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is pinned to 1792195200 for reproducible timestamps.
